green.title: Green rider
green.lead: How we keep the footprint of each show small, and how you can help.

items: No power, no PA, no generator.
The street version is fully acoustic and works under normal street lighting.
No technicians, no trucks.
Instruments, clothing and props travel in our own cars, 4 people per car.
Local and made to last.
Our sea-creature costumes and props are handmade by Imaginario de Mónica, who shares our co-working space.
Reusable games.
Jump ropes, soft throwing objects, a sea net and a lifebuoy. No confetti, balloons or anything thrown away after the show.
No printed paper.
Dossiers, riders and photos are online only, at www.VENDAVAL.cat.
Concert in the audience:
we use the festival's sound system rather than bringing our own.
Tap water or water jugs; we bring refillable bottles.
Vegetarian, local and seasonal food, with no single-use plates or cutlery where possible.
A dressing room close to the route, so no extra vehicle trips are needed.
Lodging within walking distance or on public transport.
Help us link dates: if other venues nearby are interested, we'll share the travel between them.

access.title: Access rider
access.lead: How we make the show open to everyone, and what we can prepare with you.

items: No words needed.
The show is music, circus and games. We explain the games with gestures and easily understandable examples.
Multilingual artists.
To make everyone feel at home, we can greet people in their language and say a few key words in English, German, Italian, Spanish, Catalan, Arabic, Russian, Turkish, Chinese and Japanese.
Route.
Flat routes work best. We can manage ramps and stairs, and we adapt the route and pace so wheelchair users and people with prams can follow.
On request: Touch Tour.
One hour before the show, in a quiet space, people with visual impairments can touch the clothing and its dragon appliqués, the musical instruments and the props, and meet the characters.
We work together with the venue to create accessible shows.
On request, with the venue's equipment or budget: audio description, hearing loops or headsets, vibrating backpacks (only in the amplified Concert in the audience), and sign-language interpretation.
Relaxed version.

A brass band can be too loud for some people. On request, for a planned audience, we offer a relaxed version, quieter and at a slower pace. We can walk more slowly or play in a quiet square or park. It can also take place in a hall without other visual or sound stimuli. Indoors: 5 m high and about 10 × 10 m, or larger depending on the number of participants.
Easy read.
An easy-read dossier is available at www.VENDAVAL.cat. Open the accessibility button at the bottom left and choose “Easy read”: the text on the website and the dossiers changes to easy read.
Social circus.

Our artistic director, tyle fernández, is trained in social circus (“Un circ universal”, Ateneu Popular 9 Barris, 2026, and other trainings in Germany). Our work follows the Universal Design for Social Circus (DUCS) approach.
No adaptations necessary. See the technical rider for the show's requirements.
